structure.unit: Fisheries and Habitat of the Tidal Waters

law.catch_line: Limited sale of gear licenses and permits; regulations

text.section: The Commission may limit the number of gear licenses or permits to fish, except those licenses issued pursuant to subdivisions 1 and 2 of § 28.2-402, issued for use in a specific fishery. The Commission may, despite any such limits, issue such gear licenses or permits to fish to any person who has resided for at least five years on an island in the Commonwealth that is at least three miles from the mainland.
